compiled_state.title: [ticket-lib-api]: ticket_tag/ticket_untag lack short ID resolution -> writes to orphan directory
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 4f939b9343359250407aaa5404964e82a6a0fe1f
* **PR origin:** #54

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

PR #54 added `_ticketlib_resolve_short_id` to seven mutating ops: `ticket_show` (line 127), `ticket_comment` (950), `ticket_set_file_impact` (1073), `ticket_get_file_impact` (1173), `ticket_edit` (1494), `ticket_archive` (1721), `ticket_delete` (1910). `ticket_tag` and `ticket_untag` should also accept short IDs.

#### Actual Behavior

`plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib-api.sh:1333` (`ticket_tag`) and `:1365` (`ticket_untag`) lack the `ticket_id="$(_ticketlib_resolve_short_id "$ticket_id" "$TRACKER_DIR")"` line. Passing a 9-char short ID (e.g. `abcd-ef01`) flows unresolved through `_tag_add_checked` -> `_tag_add` -> `write_commit_event` -> `mkdir -p "$tracker_dir/$ticket_id"`, silently creating an orphan directory under the short ID instead of writing to the correct 16-hex ticket directory.

`ticket_link` may have the same gap (delegates to `ticket-graph.py`); requires verification.

Reproducer (DO NOT run on production tracker):
```
.claude/scripts/dso ticket tag abcd-ef01 some-tag
ls .tickets-tracker/abcd-ef01/  # orphan dir created
```

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib-api.sh (ticket_tag, ticket_untag, possibly ticket_link)
* tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib-api.sh — add short-ID coverage for tag/untag

### 6. Logs

Reference for the resolution pattern (used by 7 sibling ops):
```bash
ticket_id="$(_ticketlib_resolve_short_id "$ticket_id" "$TRACKER_DIR")"
```
